frozen_policy: Final Test dataset is reused unchanged.
System A/B prompts, schemas, rules, and evaluation logic are reused unchanged.
Temperature, request seed, server seed, max model length, and structured-output settings remain unchanged.
Only the served model ID changes from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B to Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B.
The 9B analysis is post-hoc and must not be presented as part of the preregistered 4B primary experiment.
VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT is not used because Qwen3.5 GDN attention is unsupported by that vLLM mode.
